description: Request-level input contract for the road damage inference demo. Values are checked as supplied in the request; the file itself is not opened by the validator.

required_fields_present.why: The demo cannot build a traceable request without these fields.

format_supported.why: The Lab 02 baseline only reads .jpg/.jpeg/.png (IMAGE_EXTS in src/baseline_pipeline.py).

dimensions_valid.why: Width and height must be positive whole numbers to describe an image at all.

section_id_present.why: Lab 03: a frame without a road-section ID is rejected, because its detections cannot be added to any section summary.

source_approved.why: Lab 03: cameras outside the RDD2022 sources (six source prefixes in the training data) are out of scope for the first version, so their frames go to a person instead of the model.

size_in_evaluated_range.why: The 5,000-image training sample had a smallest side of 512 px (notebook EDA). Smaller frames were never evaluated, and thin cracks may not survive.

preprocessing_identity_matches.why: The model was evaluated with letterbox resize to 640 px; any other preprocessing would make the Lab 02 scores meaningless.
